summary: test(subscriptions): port fxa-shared subscriptions tests to jest
description:
Because:
- The fxa-shared subscriptions specs still used mocha and chai, but the code is in libs/accounts/subscriptions-legacy.

This commit:
- Ports the 7 specs to co-located jest specs in the lib (103 cases, same per-file counts).
- Moves shared plan constants to src/subscriptions/fixtures/plans.ts.
- Moves 4 stripe fixtures into the lib and product1.json to the auth server as product_123done_pro.json.
- Deletes the unread fixtures and the old test and fixture folders.

Closes FXA-14713
